scheme_name: Sikkim Grant Of Award To Transgender
other_conditions: Applicant must not be a recipient of salary, pension, or family pension from the Central or any State Government.
Applicant must have an active bank account under the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana scheme.
Grant payments cease upon the beneficiary’s death or permanent migration outside Sikkim.
benefits_summary: Monthly cash assistance of ₹12,000 for transgender children (0‑6 years) and ₹500 for unemployed qualified individuals, plus free education up to graduation.
